purpose: Record nested project containment and reconstruct prior names, dates, times, revisions, hashes and custody events without overwriting historical observations.
invariants: historical edges are never updated or deleted
a hash is integrity evidence only when independently recomputed and securely retained

model.raf_private.project_registry: immutable logical project identity and source locator
model.raf_private.custody_events: append-only observations with source_name, source_created_at, source_updated_at, timezone, observed_at, recorded_at, revision, evidence_ref and hashes
model.raf_private.project_edges: append-only typed relations; CONTAINS forms the nesting matrix
model.raf_private.project_ancestry: security_invoker recursive read model for ancestry reconstruction

relationships.CONTAINS: parent project contains child project; cycle rejected

reconstruction: read custody_events ordered by event_seq and recorded_at
read project_edges ordered by observed_at and recorded_at
walk project_ancestry recursively from child to ancestors
apply supersedes_event_id only to derive a current interpretation; preserve every predecessor

safety.private_schema: revoked from public, anon and authenticated; RLS enabled; no client policies
safety.mutation: UPDATE and DELETE rejected by append-only trigger in the candidate
safety.publication: not part of this candidate; public release remains a separate reviewed sanitized snapshot
limits: database owner or privileged provider access can bypass database triggers; external receipts remain required
event hash computation and independent recomputation are outside this SQL candidate
a Supabase row alone is not WORM storage or proof of human authorship
no provider execution, backup/restore, RLS E2E or performance result has been observed

gates: select one active provider project and authorize cost
test positive and negative anonymous/authenticated access
test cycle rejection, parent-event mismatch, supersession and rollback
only then consider a real migration
rollback: close draft PR or revert candidate commits; preserve base, predecessor and receipts; never delete custody history

F_ok: nested project identity, typed containment edges, append-only custody events and recursive reconstruction are specified
source, revision, names, dates, times, timezone, evidence refs and hashes have explicit fields
F_gap: no backup/restore or runtime RLS test
no independent review or provider readback
R3.F_next: run static SQL validation and exact-head CI on the isolated branch, then select a non-sensitive metadata-only pilot
